landing.title: A bridge between your street and a solution
landing.subtitle: Setu connects the problems you see every day with the universities and experts who can help fix them — tracked openly, from report to resolution.
landing.step1_body: Describe the issue, add a photo, mark the location.
landing.step2_body: Setu reads the report and routes it to the right university department.
landing.step3_body: Faculty and students review it, form a team, and work toward a fix.
landing.step4_body: Track the status from submitted to resolved, at any time.
